ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Service Installed
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects installation of NalDrv or PROCEXP152 services via registry-keys to non-system32 folders.
Both services are used in the tool Ghost-In-The-Logs (https://github.com/bats3c/Ghost-In-The-Logs), which uses KDU (https://github.com/hfiref0x/KDU)
 Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = "HKLM\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\NalDrv\\ImagePath" OR registry_path = "HKLM\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\PROCEXP152\\ImagePath") AND  NOT (((process_path = RGX("\\\\procexp64\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\procexp\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\procmon64\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\procmon\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\handle\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\handle64\\\.exe$")) AND Details = RGX(".*\\\\WINDOWS\\\\system32\\\\Drivers\\\\PROCEXP152\\\.SYS.*")))
